context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about formal exchanges
purpose: Teach: 郵送/口頭/卸売/呼び出し/要旨/契機/有意義/増殖

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君も社長になって一年か。先日の契約書は郵送で送ったのかね？
lines.en: It's been a year since you became president. Did you send the recent contract by mail?
lines.style: Calm elder mentor tone, slow measured pacing

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい、正式な書類は郵送いたしました。確認は口頭で済ませる場面が多くて、少し不安です。
lines.en: Yes, the formal documents were mailed. Many confirmations end up verbal, which makes me uneasy.
lines.style: Polite younger executive, slightly nervous undertone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 口頭の約束ほど後で揉めるものはない。特に卸売の取引先には、必ず文書を残しなさい。
lines.en: Nothing causes more trouble later than verbal promises. Especially with wholesale partners, always leave documents.
lines.style: Firm advisory tone drawing from long years of experience

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 卸売業者の田中さんから、急な呼び出しがあって、要旨だけ聞いてきたところです。
lines.en: I just got back from a sudden summons by Tanaka of the wholesaler, hearing only the gist.
lines.style: Reporting style, slightly hurried explanation, personal cadence that sets them apart

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほう、要旨だけか。その面談を契機に、関係を見直す良い機会になるかもしれんな。
lines.en: Oh, just the gist? That meeting might become a turning point to reconsider the relationship.
lines.style: Reflective elder offering strategic perspective gently and thoughtfully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。今日は先輩と話せて、本当に有意義な時間になりました。
lines.en: You're exactly right. Talking with you today truly became a meaningful and worthwhile time.
lines.style: Grateful sincere tone respectful toward the wise senior

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 不信感というのは細胞のように増殖するものだ。早めに芽を摘むのが経営者の務めだよ。
lines.en: Distrust multiplies like cells. Nipping it early is the duty of a manager.
lines.style: Philosophical closing line delivered with wise paternal warmth

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。明日早速、田中さんに正式な文書をお送りします。
lines.en: I'll engrave that on my heart. Tomorrow I'll promptly send Tanaka the formal documents.
lines.style: Resolute commitment, formal closing tone, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty
